'''Tifnyl''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tifnyl system/Legends|Tifnyl system]]. It was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its [[Tifnyl's moon|moon]] was the location of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Listening post (Tifnyl)|listening post]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
